title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
summary: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.
title_en: Google Value Plunges by $500bn as AI Fears Rattle Wall Street
title_zh: 谷歌市值暴跌5000亿美元，AI担忧震动华尔街
summary_en: Google's stock hit a six-month low after revealing its AI search summaries are hurting ad revenue, wiping $500bn off its market value and rattling investors across Wall Street.
summary_zh: 谷歌披露其AI搜索摘要影响广告收入后，股价跌至六个月低点，市值蒸发5000亿美元，引发华尔街投资者普遍担忧。

title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
summary: Amazon's cloud signed deals with Meta and OpenAI during the quarter, helping revenue to exceed consensus.
title_en: AWS Posts 39% Revenue Growth as Cloud Rivals Also Accelerate
title_zh: AWS营收增长39%，云服务竞争对手同样加速
summary_en: Amazon's AWS grew revenue 39% in the quarter, beating consensus, helped by cloud deals signed with Meta and OpenAI as rival cloud providers also accelerate.
summary_zh: 亚马逊AWS本季度营收增长39%，超出市场预期，得益于与Meta和OpenAI签署的云协议，竞争对手云业务同样加速增长。

title: Intel stock plunges 16% as chipmaker blames PC slowdown for weak guidance
summary: Intel has been a Wall Street darling this year due to its emergence as a player in AI, but the company is being weighed down by a struggling PC market.
title_en: Intel Stock Plunges 16% as Chipmaker Blames PC Slowdown for Weak Guidance
title_zh: 英特尔股价暴跌16%，芯片制造商将疲软指引归咎于PC市场放缓
summary_en: Intel shares fell 16% after weak guidance blamed on a struggling PC market, despite the company's growing role in AI that made it a Wall Street favorite this year.
summary_zh: 英特尔股价下跌16%，因PC市场疲软导致业绩指引疲弱，尽管该公司在AI领域的崛起使其今年成为华尔街宠儿。

title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
summary: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
title_en: Reddit Shifts to Logged-In Experience as Search Traffic Dries Up
title_zh: 搜索流量枯竭，Reddit宣布转向登录体验
summary_en: Reddit is moving away from its open-web roots toward a logged-in experience, aiming to protect its audience and business as AI reshapes how people find information online.
summary_zh: 随着AI改变人们在线获取信息的方式，Reddit正重新思考其开放网络根基，转向登录体验以保护其用户和业务。

title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
summary: Wall Street hammered Alphabet for an earnings miss that included weaker-than-expected revenue out of the company's core business.
title_en: Alphabet Earnings Miss Signals AI Beginning to Erode Search Business
title_zh: Alphabet财报不及预期，显示AI开始侵蚀搜索业务
summary_en: Alphabet missed earnings estimates as core search revenue came in weaker than expected, prompting a Wall Street selloff and marking the first real sign that AI is biting into its search business.
summary_zh: Alphabet财报不及预期，核心搜索业务收入弱于预期，引发华尔街抛售，这被视为AI开始侵蚀其搜索业务的首个真实迹象。

title: 谷歌赢了 AI 排行榜，却没赢下华尔街：Gemini 4 Carbon 登顶背后的昂贵代价
summary: 点击查看原文>
title_norm: 谷歌赢了ai排行榜却没赢下华尔街gemini4carbon登顶背后的昂贵代价
title_en: Google Tops AI Leaderboard But Not Wall Street: The Costly Price of Gemini 4 Carbon's Rise
title_zh: 谷歌赢了 AI 排行榜，却没赢下华尔街：Gemini 4 Carbon 登顶背后的昂贵代价
summary_en: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon leads AI benchmarks, but investors remain skeptical as the model's heavy compute costs raise concerns about profitability and Wall Street's confidence in Google's AI strategy.
summary_zh: 谷歌 Gemini 4 Carbon 登顶 AI 基准测试，但高昂算力成本引发投资者对其盈利能力的担忧，华尔街对谷歌 AI 战略仍持谨慎态度。

title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
title_en: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Holdings Acquires ADT for $15.3B
title_zh: OpenAI支持的Thrive Holdings以153亿美元收购ADT
summary_en: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is acquiring home security firm ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, aiming to integrate AI into the home security business.
summary_zh: OpenAI支持的Thrive Holdings以153亿美元收购家庭安防公司ADT，计划将人工智能引入家庭安防业务。

title: ServiceNow shares plunge 27% to worst day ever after earnings revive AI disruption fears
summary: ServiceNow's stock recorded its worst day ever on underwhelming third-quarter results.
title_en: ServiceNow Shares Plunge 27% in Worst Day Ever After Earnings Revive AI Disruption Fears
title_zh: ServiceNow股价暴跌27%创史上最差单日，财报重燃AI颠覆担忧
summary_en: ServiceNow stock suffered its worst single-day drop, falling 27%, after underwhelming third-quarter results reignited investor fears that AI could disrupt the enterprise software business model.
summary_zh: ServiceNow第三季度业绩不及预期，股价单日暴跌27%创史上最差表现，投资者担忧AI可能颠覆企业软件商业模式。

title: You can generate and edit Google Docs files directly in Gemini chats now
summary: Now you can generate, preview, and edit PDFs, Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown files, TXT files, and code directly within Google Gemini. The new file editing capabilities are available starting today for all Gemini users, and while PDF previews/editing works on both the web and mobile, all other file formats are only in […]
title_en: Gemini Chats Now Generate and Edit Google Docs, Sheets, and More
title_zh: Gemini聊天现可直接生成和编辑谷歌文档、表格等文件
summary_en: Google Gemini now lets all users generate, preview, and edit PDFs, Google Docs, Sheets, slide decks, Markdown, TXT, and code directly in chats. PDF editing works on web and mobile; other formats are web-only for now.
summary_zh: 谷歌Gemini现允许所有用户在聊天中直接生成、预览和编辑PDF、谷歌文档、表格、幻灯片、Markdown、TXT及代码文件。PDF编辑支持网页和移动端，其他格式暂仅限网页端。

title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.
title_en: OpenAI Releases Updated Model Spec for More Capable AI
title_zh: OpenAI发布更新版模型规范，推动AI更强大且更有益
summary_en: OpenAI published an updated Model Spec outlining five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.
summary_zh: OpenAI发布更新版模型规范，提出五项核心价值观，引导更强大的AI实现合理判断、尊重人类自主性并忠实于人类意图。

title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
summary: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.
title_en: Mistral releases weights for trillion-parameter AI model targeting cybersecurity
title_zh: Mistral发布万亿参数AI模型权重，瞄准网络安全领域
summary_en: Mistral released the weights of a trillion-parameter model aimed at cybersecurity, saying it gives organizations more control over cyber defenses than closed models allow.
summary_zh: Mistral发布了一款面向网络安全的万亿参数模型权重，称其能让机构对网络防御拥有比闭源模型更多的控制权。

title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
title_en: US Investigated Chinese Spy Plot Targeting Nvidia CEO
title_zh: 美国调查针对英伟达CEO的中国间谍阴谋
summary_en: The New York Times reports that a top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China may also have been a Chinese spy, prompting a US investigation.
summary_zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，一家被控非法向中国出售英伟达芯片的新加坡AI云公司高管可能也是中国间谍，美国已展开调查。

title: Baseten Releases joey-1, a 2B Decision Model at $0.01 per 1M Tokens
summary: Baseten has released joey-1, a 2B open-weight decision model that returns calibrated probabilities instead of text. It runs at 20 ms P50 latency and costs $0.01 per million input tokens. The post Baseten Releases joey-1, a 2B Decision Model at $0.01 per 1M Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Baseten Releases joey-1, a 2B Decision Model at $0.01 per 1M Tokens
title_zh: Baseten发布joey-1：20亿参数决策模型，每百万token仅0.01美元
summary_en: Baseten released joey-1, a 2B open-weight decision model that returns calibrated probabilities instead of text, running at 20 ms P50 latency and costing $0.01 per million input tokens.
summary_zh: Baseten发布joey-1，这是一个20亿参数的开源决策模型，输出校准概率而非文本，P50延迟20毫秒，每百万输入token仅需0.01美元。

title: 启元 CEO 田华：启元机器人接入WorkBuddy，不仅看见你的世界，还能走得到你身边
summary: 点击查看原文>
title_norm: 启元ceo田华启元机器人接入workbuddy不仅看见你的世界还能走得到你身边
title_en: Qiyuan CEO Tian Hua: Qiyuan Robots Integrate with WorkBuddy, Seeing Your World and Reaching Your Side
title_zh: 启元 CEO 田华：启元机器人接入WorkBuddy，不仅看见你的世界，还能走得到你身边
summary_en: Qiyuan CEO Tian Hua announced that Qiyuan robots now integrate with WorkBuddy, enabling them to perceive a user's environment and physically move to their location, extending robot assistance beyond vision to embodied presence.
summary_zh: 启元 CEO 田华宣布启元机器人接入 WorkBuddy，不仅能感知用户所处环境，还能移动到用户身边，将机器人辅助从视觉感知延伸到实体陪伴。

title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
summary: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.
title_en: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
title_zh: Rivian扩大与大众合资业务，纳入AI助手
summary_en: Rivian is widening its $5.8 billion joint venture with Volkswagen to cover AI assistant technology, though it did not say whether the deal's value will grow.
summary_zh: Rivian扩大与大众汽车价值58亿美元的合资业务范围，新增AI助手技术，但未透露交易金额是否随之增加。

title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
summary: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.
title_en: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
title_zh: Meta悄然推出AI时尚应用Style Sketch
summary_en: Meta launched Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that links to Instagram to build a virtual closet from shared photos, or lets users add items by snapping photos, recording videos, or uploading images.
summary_zh: Meta推出AI时尚应用Style Sketch，可连接Instagram用已分享照片构建虚拟衣橱，也支持拍照、录视频或上传图片手动添加单品。

title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass
summary: Prime Intellect released Prime Mega MoE, a backward pass for DeepSeek’s fused Mega MoE kernel. It makes the kernel trainable and speeds Qwen3 MoE training steps by up to 34% in prime-rl. The post Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass
title_zh: Prime Intellect发布Prime Mega MoE：可训练融合MoE内核，前向传播提速3.11倍
summary_en: Prime Intellect released Prime Mega MoE, adding a backward pass to DeepSeek's fused Mega MoE kernel, making it trainable and speeding Qwen3 MoE training steps by up to 34% in prime-rl.
summary_zh: Prime Intellect发布Prime Mega MoE，为DeepSeek融合Mega MoE内核增加反向传播，使其可训练，并在prime-rl中将Qwen3 MoE训练步骤提速最高34%。

title: AI+增长：员工提效了，企业为什么没多赚钱？｜上海鲸阙AI联合创始人 沈涛分享
summary: 点击查看原文>
title_norm: ai增长员工提效了企业为什么没多赚钱上海鲸阙ai联合创始人沈涛分享
title_en: AI+Growth: Employees Are More Efficient, So Why Aren't Companies Making More Money? | Shanghai Jingque AI Co-founder Shen Tao Shares
title_zh: AI+增长：员工提效了，企业为什么没多赚钱？｜上海鲸阙AI联合创始人 沈涛分享
summary_en: Shanghai Jingque AI co-founder Shen Tao examines why AI-driven employee productivity gains often fail to translate into higher corporate profits, discussing the gap between efficiency and revenue growth.
summary_zh: 上海鲸阙AI联合创始人沈涛探讨为何AI带来的员工效率提升未能转化为企业利润增长，分析效率与营收之间的落差。

title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
summary: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.
title_en: Granola adds dictation feature to take on Wispr
title_zh: Granola推出听写功能，与Wispr展开竞争
summary_en: Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker, mirroring Wispr's move into meeting notes. The voice AI rivalry between the two apps is heating up.
summary_zh: Granola在其会议记录应用中新增听写功能，回应Wispr此前加入会议笔记的举措，语音AI竞争升温。

title: Anthropic 取消编程面试：新人第一次有机会直接和资深工程师竞争
summary: 点击查看原文>
title_norm: anthropic取消编程面试新人第一次有机会直接和资深工程师竞争
title_en: Anthropic Drops Coding Interviews, Letting Newcomers Compete Directly With Senior Engineers
title_zh: Anthropic 取消编程面试：新人第一次有机会直接和资深工程师竞争
summary_en: Anthropic has removed coding interviews from its hiring process, giving junior candidates a first chance to compete directly with senior engineers for roles.
summary_zh: Anthropic 在招聘中取消编程面试环节，让初级候选人首次有机会与资深工程师直接竞争岗位。
